Romeo Doubs , DeMario Douglas and Hunter Henry had touchdown catches for the Patriots (4-2), who have won three in a row. Douglas had a team-high seven catches for 86 yards. A.J. Brown had three catches for 27 yards for the Patriots in his return from injured reserve, but his timing was off and had three drops on his 10 total targets. New England won its fourth straight against the Jets and 19th in its last 21 meetings despite right tackle Morgan Moses (ankle), left guard Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) and right guard Ben Brown (knee) leaving with injuries. The Jets (2-4) had a chance to tie it in the third quarter, but the Patriots held them to a field goal. stories.title: Falcons' Kendal Daniels hurts neck on tackle vs. Bears, hospitalized
stories.summary: Kendal Daniels is alert and has movement in all his extremities, the Falcons said Sunday, after he injured his neck on a tackle attempt vs. the Bears.
stories.detail: ATLANTA -- Kendal Daniels is alert and has movement in all his extremities, the Falcons said Sunday, after the rookie linebacker was carted off the field with a neck injury suffered on an ugly-looking collision during the team's 31-23 loss to the Chicago Bears . With the Bears leading 21-7 with 8:48 left in the third quarter, Daniels dived in to tackle Colston Loveland after a Caleb Williams pass completion and the linebacker's head appeared to collide with the tight end's left leg near the knee. Daniels remained down on the field for some time as medical personnel tended to him. They stabilized his neck and body, then loaded him onto the cart in a gurney as Falcons players and coaches gathered around and wished him well. On the way off the field, Daniels made a fist with his left hand. "He said, 'Y'all go finish this off.' He was in good spirits," quarterback Michael Penix Jr . said. The team said Daniels was taken to Grady Memorial Hospital for further evaluation. "Those are no fun for anybody," coach Kevin Stefanski said. "Players, coaches. You don't want to see anyone down like that. Kendal is a kid we all love, we all respect. "All the reports are good, and we're praying that…

stories.title: Tracking Jaguars CB/WR Travis Hunter's 2026 season: A career best in Week 6?
stories.summary: Every week, we will look at how many snaps the two-way corner/receiver plays on offense and defense. Is there a trend in his usage?
stories.detail: The Jacksonville Jaguars were emphatic in the offseason that cornerback/wide receiver Travis Hunter was going to play on both sides of the ball in 2026. However, unlike his rookie season, the plan was for the 2025 No. 2 overall pick to be a starter on defense. Now, he is just being mixed in on offense with a specific package of plays. The situation is fluid, though, and head coach Liam Coen has maintained that Hunter's usage could change weekly. "You want to continue to do what we think is going to give us the best chance at winning throughout the course of the week," he said. "And so, if that's Travis getting more touches [on offense], then [he] absolutely will." Hunter played more on offense than defense in his 2025 rookie season, which ended after seven games because of a right knee injury. The 2024 Heisman Trophy winner had 28 catches for 298 yards and a touchdown and 15 tackles and three pass breakups. He played 67% of the team's offensive snaps and 36% of the defensive snaps before his injury, which occurred during practice on Oct. 30. How has Hunter's usage evolved this season? stories.title: NFL: Steelers-Saints in Paris still on despite civil unrest, protests in France
stories.summary: The Week 7 game between the New Orleans Saints and Pittsburgh Steelers on Oct. 25 in Paris is still scheduled as planned despite civil unrest and protests in France, the NFL said.
stories.detail: The Week 7 game between the New Orleans Saints and Pittsburgh Steelers on Oct. 25 in Paris is still scheduled as planned despite civil unrest and protests in France. "Preparations continue as scheduled for NFL events and the game at Stade de France next Sunday," the NFL said in a statement. "We continue to work closely with local authorities and partners on all operational and security matters. We are also providing the two clubs with regular updates. There's been no disruption or impact at league sites." The Saints are planning to travel to Paris immediately after their game against the New York Giants in East Rutherford, New Jersey, on Sunday. The Steelers plan to practice in Pittsburgh before departing for France on Thursday. The game -- the first ever to be played in France -- will be held north of Paris at Stade de France. Saints spokesman Greg Bensel said the team concurs with the NFL's statement and is planning to play. "In addition to working closely with the NFL, we have also maintained daily security updates with our security partners in France," Bensel said. "Members of our football operations staff and internal security team have been on the ground in France for the pa…

stories.title: Nuggets' Julian Strawther to miss opening weeks of NBA season with injury
stories.summary: Denver Nuggets guard Julian Strawther will miss the opening weeks of the 2026-27 season with a left knee sprain.
stories.detail: Denver Nuggets guard Julian Strawther has been diagnosed with a left knee sprain and is expected to miss the opening weeks of the 2026-27 NBA regular season, including the season opener against the Oklahoma City Thunder on Oct. 22. The team announced that Strawther suffered the injury during a preseason matchup against the Los Angeles Clippers and will be sidelined as he undergoes rehabilitation. Strawther sustained the injury in the third quarter of the game on Oct. 16 when his leg got caught under his body, causing him to bend and land awkwardly. After undergoing an evaluation by the Nuggets' medical staff, it was determined that he had suffered a left knee sprain. Strawther will be re-evaluated in approximately six weeks to determine if he is healthy enough to resume basketball activities. Selected by Denver as the 29th overall pick in the 2023 NBA Draft, Strawther has started 18 games in his career and averaged 7.2 points over 57 appearances last season.
